reached_sql:
SELECT i.i_item_id, st.s_state, GROUPING(st.s_state) AS g_state,
       AVG(ss.ss_quantity) AS agg1,
       AVG(ss.ss_list_price) AS agg2,
       AVG(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3,
       AVG(ss.ss_sales_price) AS agg4
FROM item AS i
JOIN store_sales AS ss ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN date_dim AS d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk AND d.d_year = 1999
JOIN customer_demographics AS cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk AND cd.cd_gender = 'M' AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'W' AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
JOIN store AS st ON ss.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
WHERE st.s_state IN ('TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN')
GROUP BY ROLLUP (i.i_item_id, st.s_state)
ORDER BY i.i_item_id, st.s_state
LIMIT 100
